text: Spencer Sutherland, Toronto Music Industry Advisory Council Co-Chair will provide an update on the work planned with Responsible Hospitality Institute (RHI) on researching opportunities in developing Toronto’s night-time economy. Economic Development and Culture staff will provide an update on consultation with the music and nightlife communities on shaping Toronto’s night-time economy.
Members of the Toronto Music Industry Advisory Council discussed the item informally. The Toronto Music Industry Advisory Council will consider this item at its meeting on April 23, 2018.
